source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In your Shooting phase, once this unit has finished shooting and provided no enemy unit is within its Engagement Range, it may make a Normal move just as it could in your Movement phase; a unit that moves this way cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
